label: IGMP
notes: IGMP over IP protocol 2. The IP header of a real IGMP message carries the Router Alert option (RFC 2113; recommended by RFC 2236 §2 and RFC 3376 §2), so IHL=6 and the anchor base is 24, not 20 — scapy's IGMP layer appends exactly that option, and the fixtures keep it. The 8-byte header of Membership Query, Report and Leave messages is modelled in full; the group address is payload-embedded, so it is a first-class ipv4 field (host primitives do not reach IP payload bytes). IGMPv3 Membership Reports (type 0x22, RFC 3376 §4.2) replace the group address with a variable-length group-record list, so nothing past the type byte is fixed for them; IGMPv1 (RFC 1112) reuses the layout with the Max Resp Time byte unused.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Message type; 0x11 query is shared by all versions.

fields.label: Max Resp Time
fields.description: In a query: tenths of a second a host may wait before replying. IGMPv1 leaves it 0; IGMPv3 values ≥128 are a floating-point max resp code (RFC 3376 §4.1.1).

fields.label: Checksum
fields.description: Internet checksum over the IGMP message.

fields.label: Group Address
fields.description: 0.0.0.0 in a general query; the reported or left multicast group otherwise.
